attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 4 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and gives no year. The corpus keeps nobody of this name under any spelling — the name sweep's rows for this line were Menas and Meletius folders, a different name — and the day's line gives him the rank Όσιος, not Μάρτυς. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
